# DistributedInference

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
The execution of a single neural network inference across multiple distributed nodes, partitioning layers or neurons. Allows neuromorphic models to scale beyond single-device limits, leveraging network topology for real-time processing.
